title: New Year greeting: may every ad in 2027 teach the next one
hook: Happy New Year from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Happy New Year from all of us at Galvor.

One wish for your 2027: that every ad you run leaves you knowing a little more than the one before it.

Thank you for reading, arguing and sharing with us last year. See you on Monday.
alt_text: Festive greeting on a violet background with fireworks: Happy New Year. May every ad in 2027 teach the next one. From all of us at Galvor.
